body: I confirm the issue does not occur with the Compatibility renderer (but the project takes a full second to stop after closing the window), and that the patch gives that same behavior to the Forward and Mobile renderers. I do not have any other compositor than KWin though, so I haven't tested that.

After reporting the issue @Zamundaaa swiftly fixed this issue with the kwin MR [!9287](https://invent.kde.org/plasma/kwin/-/merge_requests/9287), which has just been merged :D

It should just be a matter of waiting now. If you want to test it you can build it yourself (see kwin's [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://invent.kde.org/plasma/kwin/-/blob/af5cc71bdcc5912ecb81cfddc16061e4ccc23364/CONTRIBUTING.md#running-kwin-from-source) for various methods). I think you can also take a look at the next (20260530) [KDE Linux](https://linux.kde.org) daily testing release when it becomes available, and test it from the live ISO.

I'll consider adding an environment variable to disable FIFO as a workaround. I can imagine other issues popping up here and there, especially as more compositors implement it. For the time being, another workaround is using [`wl-veil`](https://github.com/mahkoh/wl-proxy/tree/master/apps/wl-veil) to filter the `wp_fifo_manager_v1` global out. That should give the same effect.

KDE Plasma 6.7 got released and should now ship the fix mentioned above :D

Closing, thank you for your report!
